To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the TME stimuli responsive elements can be used to fabricate structure changing DDS to overcome the conflicting requirements of drug/gene delivery at different phases of delivery.
TME responsive DDS are able to overcome the delivery challenges by adjusting the structure, size, and charge of the DDS at different phases of delivery process.

TME stimuli responsive elements have been successfully introduced into DDS for overcoming delivery-associated challenges, which can be divided into three categories: (1) TME responsive elements that can change the size of DDS, (2) TME responsive surface charge changeable elements, and (3) TME responsive structural changeable elements.

the development of TME responsive DDS, which is expected to improve the drug/gene therapy of tumors by overcoming various delivery challenges.
the development of TME stimuli-responsive drug/gene delivery nanosystem for overcoming the delivery associated challenges.
the design, fabrication, and application of TME stimuli responsive drug/gene delivery platforms.
